summary: Cut tweet generation from gpt-5.5 to DeepSeek v4-flash with thinking disabled.
detail: Same OpenAI-compatible chat path, but V4 thinking was eating completion tokens before any tweet text landed.
evidence: First successful call returned 1 completion token vs 8 reasoning tokens when thinking stayed on.

summary: X OAuth refresh tokens rotated, then vanished because cache save was success-only.
detail: Quality-gate failures still consume a refresh. If the new token is not persisted, the GitHub secret is already stale on the next cron.
evidence: Next scheduled run died on invalid refresh token before generating copy.

summary: A quality gate that blocks every candidate also blocks shipping.
detail: STRICT=false was documented as degrade-and-post, but the code threw instead. Indie cadence dies if a filter becomes a kill switch.
evidence: All 5 formats rejected on headline overlap during a live dispatch.
